messages:
Ashley: Kicking off blue->green for gencore v2026.03.14-green. Rolling weights slowly: start 10% green across global, change window 02:00-03:00 UTC. Release notes: https://confluence.redwood/gencore/2026.03.14 :shipit:
Deploy-bot: Deploy started (id=abc123). Running: `rd-deploy start --service gencore --version v2026.03.14-green --strategy bluegreen --staged 10%`
Deploy-bot: Router update queued: `routerctl set-weight gencore green 0.10`
Maria: seeing p95 latency jump in eu-west1 already (baseline 120ms -> 240ms) at ~12 minutes after start :eyes:
Kevin: can we pause the shift and hold at 10% while we investigate?
Oliver: pausing further shift. Executing region-targeted limiter: `routerctl set-weight gencore green 0.10 --region eu-west1` to ensure other regions can continue to ramp if healthy
Deploy-bot: Region weight applied for eu-west1 (green=0.10). Global shift paused per request.
Ashley: thanks. I'm increasing canary health check window from 3m -> 10m and enabling verbose tracing for canary traffic.
Maria: error-rate for 5xx spiked from 0.3% -> 1.8% in eu-west1; traces show model server OOMs on 2 pods (OOMKilled) :warning:
Kevin: those pods are on the dedicated pool behind eu-west1 LB; could be a quantization kernel mismatch with this build. We should avoid a full rollback unless necessary. Option: pin session affinity to blue in eu-west1 so affected sessions won’t surface issues to new users.
Oliver: we can set cookie routing override: `routerctl set-cookie-affinity gencore blue --region eu-west1` — that'll keep returning users on blue.
Ashley: good call. Do it and then decide whether to rollback regionally. Also notify support and update release notes with the canary hiccup.
Deploy-bot: Cookie affinity set for eu-west1 (blue).
Maria: after pinning, new session errors reduced but backend OOMs still happening on existing green-backed requests. I'm leaning regional rollback to restore stability.
Kevin: agree. Execute targeted rollback for eu-west1 only: `rd-deploy rollback --id abc123 --region eu-west1 --version v2026.03.13-blue`
Deploy-bot: Rollback job scheduled for eu-west1. Will drain green pods in eu-west1 and shift region weight back to blue.
Ashley: performing the rollback now. Will drain connections gracefully (grace period 60s) and watch for error-rate and p95.
Deploy-bot: Rollback completed for eu-west1 at 5478901274. Region weights: eu-west1 green=0.00, blue=1.00. Global still paused at 10% for green.
Maria: post-rollback metrics look stable in eu-west1 (p95 back to ~125ms, 5xx at 0.32%). Good catch.
Oliver: I'll add a temporary guard in the router policy to prevent automated ramp beyond 10% globally until we validate model memory profile. `routerctl set-policy gencore auto-ramp-threshold 0.10`
Ashley: documenting in release notes and marking this release as "partial canary - eu-west1 rolled back, investigating memory regression". I'll also create a follow-up ticket for model-runtime debug and add owners.
Kevin: propose we re-run the canary with a debug build (extra allocation logging) in a non-prod cluster before resuming global ramp.
Maria: agree. For now, marking this thread resolved unless we see another spike.
Oliver: ack :white_check_mark:
Ashley: thanks everyone. Closing out. I'll post a short postmortem after root cause confirmed.
